## Description

**What**: Update existing documentation to reflect the changes shipped by S1–S7 + S_migration. Create one ADR documenting the S4(b) version-bump design decision and the SC5(c) carve-out for S3's contract-preserving behavior change. Update reference docs: `HOOKS-REFERENCE.md`, `CI-INTEGRATION.md`, `WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`, `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`, and the `external-dependencies-block.md` contract (for any new fields if introduced).

**Why**: New reviewers, integrators, and DSO maintainers need to understand the new sub-PR review workflow, provenance skip semantics, large-diff chunking behavior, and worktree cleanup guards. Without doc updates, the deployed behavior surprises operators.

**Scope**:
- IN: Updates to `HOOKS-REFERENCE.md`, `CI-INTEGRATION.md`, `WORKTREE-GUIDE.md`, `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`; one new ADR at `docs/adr/<next-number>-version-bump-design.md` covering both S4(b)'s timing decision and the SC5(c) carve-out for S3's review-skip semantics; running `doc-router.md` gates before writing each target; following `.claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md` if present.
- OUT: CLAUDE.md edits (rejected per epic Constraint #6 + Doc-Router Gate 5 — process guardrails are enforced by mechanism, not documentation).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the `doc-router.md` gates have been run for each documentation target and a `DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION` block is attached to this ticket's completion report.
  ← Satisfies: Doc-router attestation requirement

- When this story is complete, `HOOKS-REFERENCE.md`, `CI-INTEGRATION.md`, and `WORKTREE-GUIDE.md` are updated to reflect the new behavior shipped by S1–S7 + S_migration.
  ← Satisfies: Doc-router Gate 2 (extends an existing reference doc)

- When this story is complete, a new ADR exists at `docs/adr/<next-number>-version-bump-design.md` covering: (a) the S4(b) version-bump-timing design decision (bump-before vs. bump-after final review), and (b) the SC5(c) carve-out for S3's contract-preserving behavior change.
  ← Satisfies: Doc-router Gate 4 (decision rationale) + Red team Finding #10 (SC5(c) carve-out)

- When this story is complete, any `CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE` reports (if generated by `doc-router.md`) are surfaced to the user for approval before this story closes.
  ← Satisfies: Doc-router CLAUDE.md report-only policy

## Considerations

- [Doc-router policy] CLAUDE.md edits are routed through a `CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE` report only — never written directly by the doc-writer agent.
- [Style] Follow `.claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md` if present.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed with best judgment. Make and document reasonable assumptions. Do not escalate for uncertainty — use your best assessment of the intent and move forward.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect sub-PR LLM review + provenance-narrowed integration review + chunked oversized-PR fallback + merge-pipeline guards
